name: ljosalfar_warrior
description: a Ljosalfar Warrior (Fall from Heaven), a wood-elf woman with long pointed ears and green eyes: long flowing blonde hair, a green leaf tunic with a leaf-shaped hem, a green leaf pauldron with a silver rim on her left shoulder, a round silver brooch, a brown leather belt with a silver buckle, brown leather leggings with gold knee bands and brown boots, a thick wooden club wrapped in gold vines and green leaves raised in her RIGHT hand (screen-left), and a round green shield with a silver rim and a white leaf emblem on her LEFT arm (screen-right)
hands: the vine-wrapped club stays in her right hand on the screen-left side and the round leaf shield on her left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the vine-wrapped club is lifted beside the head with its thick knotted head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the club hand behind the head and the vine-wrapped club hanging down behind the shoulders to the left, the green leaf shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the club arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the club is level, its thick knotted head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: club arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the vine-wrapped club smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the green leaf shield swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the club carries on down until its knotted head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, long blonde hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the club comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, the green leaf shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (club arm thrown up and out to the left, the green leaf shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the club dipping, the green leaf shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, club arm flung up, the green leaf shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the vine-wrapped club lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the club's knotted head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the club slips out of the hand, legs slide forward, long blonde hair flying
death.5: hits the ground: lying on her back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left, blonde hair spread on the ground; the vine-wrapped club lies on the ground at the lower-right; the round green leaf shield lies flat beside her
death.6: bounce: head and shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the leaf shield rocks
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on her back, eyes closed, the vine-wrapped club and the green leaf shield on the ground beside her
